How to Play

A quick tour of everything you can do. Your work saves on this device and it all runs fully offline — no internet, ever.

1

Pick a mandala

Tap START, choose a design from the gallery, then press BEGIN. New designs unlock as you finish the ones before them.

2

Tap to color

Tap any shape to fill it with your selected color. Tap it again with a different color to change it.

3

The color bar

Along the bottom is your five-color palette plus the eraser (the white swatch with the red ring). Swipe the bar to browse every available color — it loops around — and tap the ⇆ button to switch the bar between horizontal and vertical.

4

Make your palette

Pull the color bar up to open the palette editor: tap a slot, then choose any swatch from All Colors to drop it in. Close it and your new palette is ready in the bar. (You can also edit it from COLOR PALETTE in the menu.)

5

Handy tools

Tap the Up Arrow on the right to open extra tools: a brush to fill by dragging across shapes, an eyedropper to grab a color straight from your artwork, and a reset to start the mandala over.

6

Zoom, pan & undo

Pinch to zoom into the fine center detail and drag to move around. Tap the frame button to fit the whole mandala again, and the curved arrow at the top of the side buttons to undo your last fill.

7

Save & personalize

Tap the check mark in the top bar to mark a mandala complete. In Settings you can switch between Light and Dark themes and set the music and sound volume.
